name: moh731V2023Moh729bArtBase
description: MOH 729B F-MAPS, ART clients: the clients active and on ART this month in the HIV monthly report dataset (etl.hiv_monthly_report_dataset_frozen) for the month ending on the period's end date, at the requested locations -- one row per client -- with their current ARVs from their latest clinical HIV summary (flat_hiv_summary_v15b, next_clinical_datetime_hiv IS NULL). cur_arv_meds holds concept ids joined by ' ## ', single drugs or fixed-dose combinations, so the same regimen can be stored either way; regimen_signature breaks it into its components in a fixed order (e.g. TDF+3TC+DTG whether stored as 628 ## 802 ## 9759 or as the combination concept DTG/3TC/TDF (10268)), with OTHER for any concept not known as an ARV.

join.joinCondition: s.person_id = f.person_id AND s.is_clinical_encounter = 1 AND s.next_clinical_datetime_hiv IS NULL
pn.person_name_id = (SELECT pn2.person_name_id FROM amrs.person_name pn2 WHERE pn2.person_id = f.person_id AND pn2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = f.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 28 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)
(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = f.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 8 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

columns.comment: Age at the end of the reporting month, so a month reads the same whenever it is run.
The line as reported at the visit (filled for every client, where cur_arv_line often is not); 1st line when unknown.
